# Vennila Sooben

> Montréal-based software developer specializing in AI-assisted workflow automation with code, low-code, and no-code tools.

Canonical profile: https://vennilasooben.dev/

## Professional focus

- Software development with TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, Vue 3, Nuxt, and React
- Workflow automation with Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power BI, and Copilot Studio
- Academic LLM application development using prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LangChain, and CrewAI
- Process analysis, accessible frontend systems, design systems, and technical delivery

## Current context

Vennila is an M.Sc. Computer Science student at Université de Montréal. Her industry work spans process analysis, Microsoft Power Platform automation, frontend development, and academic software tools. Her research examines reusable prompt patterns through large-scale prompt analysis, taxonomy design, and specification.
